                var getUriParamsForAdvertisement = function() {
            var query_string = {}
            var query = window.location.search.substring(1);
            var parmsArray = query.split('&');

            if(parmsArray.length <= 0) return query_string;

            for(var i = 0; i < parmsArray.length; i++) {
                var pair = parmsArray[i].split('=');
                var val = decodeURIComponent(pair[1]);

                if (val != '' && pair[0] != '') query_string[pair[0]] = val;
            }

            return query_string;
        }();

            // Define and Configure Render Slots
                                        
            // Preserve the site context for all subsequent requests
            api.keepSiteContext(true);

            // Get consent and send request via eventlistener.

            // Set DSA Parameters [PORTAL-2529]
            api.setDsaOptions({
                dsarequired: 1,
                dsapubrender: 2,
                dsadatatopubs: 2
            });

            // -- Start des Eventlisteners --
            const callback = (tcData, success) => {
                // Wenn Eventlistener ein Event empfaengt, und das Event den Status "tcloaded" oder "useractioncomplete" hat, dann wird der Consentstringt an den Aditionrequest gehaengt und Adition durch api.load().completeRendering() requested.
                if (success && ((tcData.eventStatus === 'tcloaded') || (tcData.eventStatus === 'useractioncomplete'))) {
                    // Wenn purpose 1 = true, dann wird das profil consent=optin uebergeben, ansonsten consent=optout.
                    let prfConsent = 'unknown';
                    if (tcData.purpose.consents[1] === true) {
                        api.setProfile("consent","optin");
                        prfConsent = 'optin';
                    } else {
                        api.setProfile("consent","optout");
                        prfConsent = 'optout';
                    }
                    function load_Adition() {
                        api.identityService.clearOptout();
                        api.load().completeRendering();
                    }
                    setTimeout(load_Adition, 100);
                } else if (success && (tcData.eventStatus === 'cmpuishown')) {
                    // Wenn der Eventlistener greift, aber der Consentbanner noch eingeblendet ist.
                    api.setProfile("consent","unknown");
                    api.load().completeRendering();
                }
            }

            i = 1;

            function gettcfapi() {
                // Die Funktion wird nur ausgefuehrt, wenn i unter 100 ist. i wird pro Durchlauf um 1 erhoeht. Somit wird die funktion nach 5 Sekunden, sofern kein __tcfapi vorhanden ist, abgerbochen (100*50ms = 5000ms = 5Sek).
                if (i < 100) {
                    // Es wird versucht den Eventlistener fuer die Cmp zu registrieren. Das Laden der Cmp-Funktionen kann kurz dauern.
                    try {
                        __tcfapi('addEventListener', 2, callback);
                    } catch(e) {
                        // Wenn die Abfrage des EventListeners in der __tcfapi nicht erfolgreich war, dann wird die Funktion nochmal gestartet.
                        i = i + 1;
                        setTimeout(gettcfapi, 50);
                    }
                }
            }
            gettcfapi();
        });

        const advReveal = $('#slot_slider_reveal');
        const aSwipeThreshold = {x: null, y: null};
        const aSwipeStart = {x: null, y: null};

                advReveal.on('keydown', function(ev) {
            if (ev.key === 'ArrowLeft' || ev.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                advReveal.foundation('close');
            }
        });

                advReveal
            .on('touchstart', function(ev) {
                const isLandscape = window.screen.orientation.type.startsWith('landscape');

                aSwipeThreshold.x = Math.round(advReveal.width() / (isLandscape ? 6 : 4));
                aSwipeThreshold.y = Math.round(advReveal.height() / (isLandscape ? 4 : 6));

                aSwipeStart.x = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageX : ev.originalEvent.pageX;
                aSwipeStart.y = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageY : ev.originalEvent.pageY;
            })
            .on('touchmove', function(ev) {
                const x = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageX : ev.originalEvent.pageX;
                const y = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageY : ev.originalEvent.pageY;
                const dX = Math.abs(aSwipeStart.x - x);
                const dY = Math.abs(aSwipeStart.y - y);

                if (dX >= aSwipeThreshold.x || dY >= aSwipeThreshold.y) {
                    advReveal.foundation('close');
                }
            })
        ;
    </script>

        const advReveal = $('#slot_slider_reveal');
        const aSwipeThreshold = {x: null, y: null};
        const aSwipeStart = {x: null, y: null};

                advReveal.on('keydown', function(ev) {
            if (ev.key === 'ArrowLeft' || ev.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                advReveal.foundation('close');
            }
        });

                advReveal
            .on('touchstart', function(ev) {
                const isLandscape = window.screen.orientation.type.startsWith('landscape');

                aSwipeThreshold.x = Math.round(advReveal.width() / (isLandscape ? 6 : 4));
                aSwipeThreshold.y = Math.round(advReveal.height() / (isLandscape ? 4 : 6));

                aSwipeStart.x = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageX : ev.originalEvent.pageX;
                aSwipeStart.y = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageY : ev.originalEvent.pageY;
            })
            .on('touchmove', function(ev) {
                const x = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageX : ev.originalEvent.pageX;
                const y = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageY : ev.originalEvent.pageY;
                const dX = Math.abs(aSwipeStart.x - x);
                const dY = Math.abs(aSwipeStart.y - y);

                if (dX >= aSwipeThreshold.x || dY >= aSwipeThreshold.y) {
                    advReveal.foundation('close');
                }
            })
        ;
    </script>

        const advReveal = $('#slot_slider_reveal');
        const aSwipeThreshold = {x: null, y: null};
        const aSwipeStart = {x: null, y: null};

                advReveal.on('keydown', function(ev) {
            if (ev.key === 'ArrowLeft' || ev.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                advReveal.foundation('close');
            }
        });

                advReveal
            .on('touchstart', function(ev) {
                const isLandscape = window.screen.orientation.type.startsWith('landscape');

                aSwipeThreshold.x = Math.round(advReveal.width() / (isLandscape ? 6 : 4));
                aSwipeThreshold.y = Math.round(advReveal.height() / (isLandscape ? 4 : 6));

                aSwipeStart.x = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageX : ev.originalEvent.pageX;
                aSwipeStart.y = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageY : ev.originalEvent.pageY;

            .on('touchmove', function(ev) {
                const x = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageX : ev.originalEvent.pageX;
                const y = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageY : ev.originalEvent.pageY;
                const dX = Math.abs(aSwipeStart.x - x);
                const dY = Math.abs(aSwipeStart.y - y);

                if (dX >= aSwipeThreshold.x || dY >= aSwipeThreshold.y) {
                    advReveal.foundation('close');
                }
            })

        const aSwipeThreshold = {x: null, y: null};

                advReveal.on('keydown', function(ev) {
            if (ev.key === 'ArrowLeft' || ev.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                advReveal.foundation('close');
            }
        });

                advReveal
            .on('touchstart', function(ev) {
                const isLandscape = window.screen.orientation.type.startsWith('landscape');

                aSwipeThreshold.x = Math.round(advReveal.width() / (isLandscape ? 6 : 4));
                aSwipeThreshold.y = Math.round(advReveal.height() / (isLandscape ? 4 : 6));

                aSwipeStart.x = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageX : ev.originalEvent.pageX;
                aSwipeStart.y = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageY : ev.originalEvent.pageY;
            })
            .on('touchmove', function(ev) {
                const x = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageX : ev.originalEvent.pageX;
                const y = ev.originalEvent.targetTouches.length ? ev.originalEvent.targetTouches[0].pageY : ev.originalEvent.pageY;
                const dX = Math.abs(aSwipeStart.x - x);
                const dY = Math.abs(aSwipeStart.y - y);

                if (dX >= aSwipeThreshold.x || dY >= aSwipeThreshold.y) {
                    advReveal.foundation('close');
                }
            })
        ;
    </script>
